## 7.5 施密特正交化——构造标准正交基
施密特正交化（Gram-Schmidt）: 设$\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2}, \dots ,\alpha_{k}$线性无关。递归构造正交向量组$\beta_{1}, \dots ,\beta_{k}$：
$$
\beta_{1} = \alpha_{1}
$$
$$
\beta_{2} = \alpha_{2} - \frac{\alpha_{2} \cdot \beta_{1}}{\beta_{1} \cdot \beta_{1}} \cdot \beta_{1}
$$
$$
\beta_{3} = \alpha_{3} - \frac{\alpha_{3} \cdot \beta_{1}}{\beta_{1} \cdot \beta_{1}} \cdot \beta_{1} - \frac{\alpha_{3} \cdot \beta_{2}}{\beta_{2} \cdot \beta_{2}} \cdot \beta_{2}
$$
通用规律：每个新向量 $=$ 原向量 $-$ 在所有已得正交向量上的投影之和。
单位化：$\eta_{i} = \beta_{i}/|\beta_{i}|$，得到标准正交向量组$\eta_{1},\eta_{2}, \dots ,\eta_{k}$。
##### 分层例题
**【计算层】**将 $\alpha_{1}=(1,1,0), \alpha_{2}=(1,0,1), \alpha_{3}=(0,1,1)$ 标准正交化。
解——正交化：
$$
\beta_{1} = \alpha_{1} = (1,1,0)
$$
$$
\beta_{2} = \alpha_{2} - \frac{\alpha_{2} \cdot \beta_{1}}{\beta_{1} \cdot \beta_{1}} \cdot \beta_{1} = (1,0,1) - \frac{1}{2} \cdot (1,1,0) = (\frac{1}{2}, -\frac{1}{2}, 1)
$$
$$
\beta_{3} = \alpha_{3} - \frac{\alpha_{3} \cdot \beta_{1}}{\beta_{1} \cdot \beta_{1}} \cdot \beta_{1} - \frac{\alpha_{3} \cdot \beta_{2}}{\beta_{2} \cdot \beta_{2}} \cdot \beta_{2}
$$
$$
= (0,1,1) - \frac{1}{2} \cdot (1,1,0) - \frac{\frac{1}{2}}{\frac{3}{2}} \cdot (\frac{1}{2},-\frac{1}{2},1)
$$
$$
= (0,1,1) - (\frac{1}{2},\frac{1}{2},0) - (\frac{1}{6},-\frac{1}{6},\frac{1}{3}) = (-\frac{2}{3}, \frac{2}{3}, \frac{2}{3})
$$
单位化：$|\beta_{1}|=\sqrt{2} \rightarrow \eta_{1}=(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}, \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}, 0)$；$|\beta_{2}|=\sqrt{\frac{3}{2}} \rightarrow \eta_{2}=(\frac{1}{\sqrt{6}}, -\frac{1}{\sqrt{6}}, \frac{2}{\sqrt{6}})$；$|\beta_{3}|=\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}} \rightarrow \eta_{3}=(-\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}, \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}, \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}})$。✓
定理 7.3（正交向量组线性无关）: 两两正交的非零向量组一定线性无关。
derivation: 原始三维向量: u_i=v_i-sum_j proj_qj(v_i); q_i=u_i/||u_i||
投影分量: u_i=v_i-sum_j proj_qj(v_i); q_i=u_i/||u_i||
正交残差: u_i=v_i-sum_j proj_qj(v_i); q_i=u_i/||u_i||
证明: 设$\sum c_{i}v_{i}=0$，两边与$v_{j}$做内积：$\sum c_{i}(v_{i} \cdot v_{j})=c_{j}|v_{j}|^{2}=0 \rightarrow c_{j}=0$。■

单位化：$\eta_{i} = \beta_{i}/|\beta_{i}|$，得到标准正交向量组$\eta_{1},\eta_{2}, \dots ,\eta_{k}$。

**【计算层】**将 $\alpha_{1}=(1,1,0), \alpha_{2}=(1,0,1), \alpha_{3}=(0,1,1)$ 标准正交化。

$$

$$
$$
